DCHP-301.name: Spirituality, Religion, and Medicine
DCHP-301.description: Explores religious and spiritual beliefs in health and patient care, including culturally competent integration strategies and their ethical limits.

category_review.rationale: The actual course combines religious/cultural and ethical analysis with strategies for integrating spirituality into patient care; both human interpretation and professional health practice are substantive.

GLPH-455.name: Global Health with International Field Experience
GLPH-455.description: Studies health systems and social determinants through international field research, cultural preparation and a collaboratively designed educational program for local children.
GLPH-455.prerequisites: Prerequisites: GLPH-101 or GLPH-355 or equivalent course.
notes: Required travel occurs during spring break or immediately after the semester, depending on destination. Additional travel expenses are announced before registration. Pre-travel cultural orientation and collaborative work with local hosts are required.

category_review.locator: GLPH-455 complete public popup under 2026–2027 curriculum
category_review.rationale: Field health-system research and delivery of a local educational program coexist with explicit cultural, religious and social-determinant analysis.
